name: Lying Reverse Fly
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells with arms hanging.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are in line with your torso.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A rear-delt fly performed lying on a bench that isolates the upper back.
